description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawChatViewModel in the OpenClawKit project. It includes setup functions, mock transport implementations, and extensive test cases to verify chat session handling, message streaming, model selection, session management, and user interactions within the chat UI component.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A simple actor-based class to store string values, used for test callbacks.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An actor used to synchronize asynchronous test flows, allowing tests to wait and release at specific points.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: A thread-safe actor counter used to verify correct retry/counting behavior in tests.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: Internal state holder for the mock transport, tracking call counts and recorded parameters.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport for testing, simulating message exchanges, session management, and event emission.

methods.name: chatTextMessage
methods.description: Creates a structured mock message with role, text, and timestamp.

methods.name: historyPayload
methods.description: Generates a OpenClawChatHistoryPayload with optional session details.

methods.name: sessionEntry
methods.description: Creates a new session entry with specified key, timestamp, and optional model info.

methods.name: makeViewModel
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel with mocked responses and hooks for testing.

methods.name: loadAndWaitBootstrap
methods.description: Loads the ViewModel and waits until it is bootstrap complete.

methods.name: sendUserMessage
methods.description: Simulates the user sending a message within the ViewModel after setting input.

methods.name: sendMessageAndEmitFinal
methods.description: Sends a user message, waits for the run to start, then emits a final message event.

methods.name: emitAssistantText
methods.description: Emits a streaming assistant message event.

methods.name: emitToolStart
methods.description: Emits a tool call start event.

methods.name: emitExternalFinal
methods.description: Emits an external final chat event.
